scientific_integrity: Proof and provenance are contained in RESULT.md; verifier is a finite supporting check, not a proof. General Gaussian ratio-of-quadratic-forms literature may contain overlapping material. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-dimensional, real symmetric positive-definite target and covariance, one Gaussian sketch column, exact arithmetic. Angular minimax restricts the covariance leading eigendirection to the estimated target direction; the target spectrum is fixed. The anisotropic best value may be an unattained singular-covariance limit. No high-dimensional, computational-cost or non-Gaussian optimality is asserted.
title: A sharp angular-information threshold for planar Gaussian Nyström covariance design
